hypothesis: Envelope wages: the declared average wage stays at the minimum wage month after month, while most companies of the same activity in the same municipality pay more.
legitimate_explanations: Part-time staff (the average is per insured person, not per hour); a low-wage activity or region (the peer percentile is then low); trainees, students and apprentices; a new or seasonal business still hiring; owners who pay themselves dividends rather than wages.
sources: stg_sodra__monthly (avg_wage, published for employers with more than 3 insured), minimum_wages, int_company_months
